name: chatmate
description: Connects your AI to your Telegram through your personal ChatMate bot: read the chats you connected, give tasks in the bot, and get answers, drafts and results back in Telegram.

interface.shortDescription: Your Telegram chats in the conversation
interface.longDescription: Connect the Telegram chats of your personal ChatMate bot. Follow a person across private chats and groups, see group reactions, earlier edits, deleted private messages without content and forum topic names. Get a reply or an approval request in your bot. New chats you connect in Telegram appear automatically.
defaultPrompt: What did people write to me on Telegram today?
Find the message where we agreed on the price.
